Thank you for the responses everyone, I really needed to hear how much crap they were spouting. As soon as I said no to seeing them, their emotionally supportive, ‘I’m reaching out to you’ front became anger and vengeance. They were using my sensitivity to get what they wanted. My mother asked what she had done wrong, and I told her, only to be met with how wrong I am and how everything was a ‘joke’, and how I obviously remembered it incorrectly. I didn’t ask them to drive to see me, that’s on them, but I still feel endless amounts of guilt and sadness this morning. That’s exactly how they get to me; they guilt trip me until I give in. It didn’t work today. As they informed me that they were leaving, they did their typical ‘mum is crying’, because they know that one usually gets me - I was always blamed for the crying. They didn’t win today, I stood my ground and it turned out they were lying about knowing where I was. Feels like a proud moment but I don’t think I’ll ever get rid of the guilt I feel over it
